_about: Example inputs: braces and aligners in Indonesia (Nov 2026). Copy it for a new product and replace every value AND its source. A value is one number or {low, base, high}. Prices are in rupiah per case.

target_share.source: BPS SP2020: Gen Z 27.94% + Millennials 25.87% (about age 13-44 in 2025)

need_share.source: IOTN DHC 4-5: Oley 2015 12.5%; Suala & Wibowo 2021 review mean 20.6%; high = Assumption

ability_to_pay_share.source: BPS 2024 middle class 17.13%; low = 80% of it; high adds 10% of the aspiring middle class (49.22%) via instalments

providers.source: PDGI certification register, orthodontic specialists (Sp.Ort), 14 Nov 2026

cases_per_provider.source: Assumption; US 2025 benchmark 295 starts per orthodontist used only as a ceiling

secondary_providers.source: PDGI certification register, general dentists, 14 Nov 2026

metal.source: Incl. ~20 control visits: OCBC 2024 Rp 5-12 jt install; Suara 2023 Rp 300-500 rb per visit

self_ligating.source: Clinic price pages, Damon Rp 10-35 jt packages

aligner.source: OCBC 2024 Rp 15-65 jt; clinic pages up to Rp 75 jt
